'''''Dooku Boot''''' was the name of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunship used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Dooku_Boot_nose_art.jpg|thumb|left|180px|''Dooku Boot'' nose art]]
The nose of this [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] was customized with a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] getting booted in the backside by a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper's]] [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Limb/Legends|leg]].<ref name="Weapons Factory" />

==History==
''Dooku Boot'' was used in the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]] of the Clone Wars. It was the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]] that delivered [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], to the staging point for the assault on [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser's]] new [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|droid foundry]]. It was also used to extract survivors of the battle after the foundry was destroyed.<ref name="Weapons Factory" />
